apps.title: My Web Applications
apps.desc: Demonstrations of fullstack interfaces and solutions developed to simplify business analysis.

1.title: CreditFlow - Credit Application Management Platform
1.desc: Comprehensive web application for managing the lifecycle of microfinance credit applications. Allows structured collection of customer data with photo capture, automated financial analysis, risk assessment through scoring, expert synthesis and opinion on the case via a 360° AI view, and collegial decision-making with electronic signatures and total traceability.
1.f1: Multi-role management with cascading validation workflow (Collector → Supervisor → Analyst → Director → Committee)
1.f2: Photo capture of ID cards, GPS position, and guarantor information
1.f3: Risk scoring and weighting system with automatic AI-based recommendations

2.title: Boutique Operations Management Application
2.desc: Comprehensive commercial management web application for small and medium-sized shops. This all-in-one solution allows merchants to digitalize and optimize all their operations: sales, stocks, customers, suppliers, production, and finance. Accessible from any device with real-time synchronization.
2.f1: Product management with add, edit, and delete functions
2.f2: Sales tracking and product performance analysis

3.title: Association Finance Management Application
3.desc: Comprehensive financial management solution for associations, clubs, and community organizations. Automates tracking of monthly dues, management of event contributions, and generation of professional reports. Designed to simplify life for treasurers and improve financial transparency.
3.f1: Complete member management with detailed profiles and Excel import
3.f2: Automated tracking of monthly dues with a visual calendar
3.f3: Generation of professional printable financial reports (PDF)
